evidence.quote: Consumers were not affected during the frequency stability tests or when synchronous operation with the continental European grid started. The voltage regulation tests were successfully carried out on the high voltage 330kV network, and the voltage changes were within the planned range without affecting the quality of the power supply and the electrical installations of the consumers.

claims.explanation: The source directly states that consumers were not affected during the frequency stability tests or when synchronous operation with the continental European grid started. It also mentions that voltage regulation tests were successful and voltage changes were within the planned range without affecting power supply quality or electrical installations of consumers. This confirms the claim that consumers were not affected at the time of synchronization.
